SaveName: Haute & Hazard — Solo Circuit v0.1 Add-On
Note: Experimental Solo Circuit add-on. Additive-load into v7.8 Standard Setup.
Rules: Use docs/SOLO_CIRCUIT_AUTOMA_PLAYTEST.md. Experimental; not canonical v7.8 multiplayer.

ObjectStates.Name: Notecard
ObjectStates.Description:
EXPERIMENTAL ONE-PLAYER MODULE

1. Load the normal Haute & Hazard v7.8 Standard Setup.
2. Additively load this Solo Circuit save.
3. Choose a House Queen Personality or play generic.
4. Shuffle the 18-card Automa deck.
5. Recommended first test: Working Queen difficulty + Beginner Mode.

ROUND: Reveal 1 Automa → resolve Wardrobe removal/refill → take normal turn → calculate House Appeal → check Slay.

After 3 failed Stage rounds, House claims the Stage.

DRAGDAGULAN†: player draws normal 3. House reveals 3 Automa; use printed LS only and ignore battle-card effects. Apply difficulty LS once.

Local Girl -2 Appeal/-1 LS | Working Queen printed | Headliner +1 Appeal | Legend +2 Appeal/+1 LS.

† Working prototype term; subject to legal/IP and publisher review.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — TREASURE FROM TRASH

Whenever the Automa removes a Market card costing 2 or less, +1 House Appeal this round.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — IDOL PERFECT

Whenever the Automa removes a Pink Fashion card, gain 1 Match token. At 3, gain 1 Gross SP and clear the tokens.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — FROM THE GRAVE

Once per Stage, set aside the resolved Automa card. During the next round, add +1 House Appeal, then discard it normally.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — MORE IS MORE

The first time each round an Automa effect gives House Queen +1 or more Appeal, add +1 additional House Appeal.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — TOXIC ENTRANCE

Whenever the Automa removes a Blue Fashion card, player archives 1 card from hand if able. Maximum once per round.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — DUALITY

If House Wardrobe contains at least two non-Neutral Tenets, +1 House Appeal. If it contains all four, +2 instead.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — PERFECT GEOMETRY

Whenever House Queen gains Gross SP, gain +1 House Appeal on the next Automa round.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — SUGAR HIGH

Whenever the Automa removes Pink Shoes, reveal the next Automa card and use the higher Appeal; discard the extra card without resolving it.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — BUILT TO WALK

Whenever the Automa removes Shoes, +1 House Appeal this round.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — FULL SPECTRUM

Once per Stage, when House Wardrobe contains Face, Wig, Body, and Shoes, gain 1 Gross SP.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — SACRIFICE

Once per Stage, discard the top Automa card without resolving it to add +2 House Appeal if House would otherwise miss the Slay Target by exactly 1 or 2.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.

ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description:
House Queen Personality — FINAL GIRL

Whenever House Queen wins Dragdagulan†, gain 1 Gross SP. If the House wins by 3+, gain 2 instead.

Use one optional Personality with the 18-card House Queen Automa deck.
